title: How Are You?
label: ch:ur-how-are-you
canDo: I can ask how someone is with respectful āp, choose kaise or kaisī for the person I am addressing, and reply that I am fine, thank you. I can join four letters into salām, and write kāf and nūn.

payoff.summary: The wellbeing exchange run both ways — āp kaise haiṅ? and āp kaisī haiṅ? — answered with the unchanging maiṅ ṭhīk hūṅ, shukriyā; then its pieces recalled without the page, its words read in script, and سلام, kāf and nūn written by hand.
payoff.note: UR-C04-practice is the chapter's last lesson (sequence 160, after UR-W04-nun, now a prerequisite) and assesses all nineteen atoms the chapter introduces: the exchange both ways, a spoken recall of kaise/kaisī, the maiṅ ... hūṅ frame and ṭhīk with its Hindi twin, and a script section reading کیسے, کیسی, میں, ٹھیک and ہوں and writing a joined سلام, ک and ن.
